**Idioms and Proverbial Phrases**
40. Pick out an appropriate analogy:
Toss: Hurl:
(A) Speak: Shout
(C) Consider: Formulate
(B) Forget: learn
(D) None of these
41. Please fill in the blank identifying analogous expression:
Lithe: ____ : Slovenly: Snob
(A) Filth
(C) Dance
(B) Asleep
(D) None of these
42. Spot the substitute for the given sentence:
A post for which no salary is paid.
(A) Herbivorous
(C) Honorary
(B) Homicide
(D) None of these
43. Fill in the blank identifying and analogous expression: Impious: ____ : indignant: irked
(A) Irreverent
(C) Furious
(B) Irk some
(D) None of these
44. Choose the best meaning of the idiomatic phrase: To turn the tables
(A) to turn someone
(B) to turn the situation to one's own side
(C) to reverse the condition completely
(D) None of these

(A) Urbane: Fanatic
(B) Muzzle: Dog

51. Change of voice: Choose the correct option.

(D) None of these
